model_policy: Reuse independently verified same-date upstream heads and existing 255-column scorer; fit one normal-history Huber GMPI per AS
parameter_selection: Frozen after 0201; no 0301/0401 final route labels select parameters

selection_policy.augmentation: source's own unified tree plus original TRAIN donor tails; existing 255-column scorer
selection_policy.final_model: unchanged normal-history Huber GMPI; source pair-disjoint validation
selection_policy.high_recursion: expand every selected root independent of tail capacity; only S-N-A leaves
selection_policy.high_root_selection: dual raw-ranker Top3 union only; no score-based additions
selection_policy.low_root_limit_provenance: User-designated 0201 original TRAIN K80 P90=21; fixed engineering count, not per-target route selection
selection_policy.low_root_selection: unchanged dual Top3 protection, scores and mean-support threshold; max_k=21

quality.semantics: All candidates are source pools: use original source q0.75/min1000. Neighbor q0.90 applies only to the removed neighbor-first splice protocol.

selection_policy.query_tree: high: full selected source tree also used for augmentation; low: original S-N Tree B+PG
